notes: Added missing schema, core builder logic, API exposure, integration wiring, and test coverage stories for explainability layer.

change_log.note: Integration with provider and trial signals

stories.title: Explainability Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (source, meaning, limitations) using Pydantic models to enforce consistency across provider and clinical trial evaluation signals.

stories.title: Core Explainability Builder Logic
stories.description: Implement backend service logic to construct explainability objects from raw evaluation signals (credentials, links, trial data), normalizing fields and attaching contextual explanations.

stories.title: Expose Explainability via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include explainability fields in API responses, ensuring all evaluation outputs return structured explainability alongside raw data.

stories.title: Integrate Explainability Across Evaluation Pipelines
stories.description: Integrate explainability builder into both provider and clinical trial pipelines so all signals are enriched before reaching the facade, ensuring no signal bypasses explainability processing.

stories.title: Explainability Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for explainability schema and builder logic, plus integration tests validating explainability presence and correctness in end-to-end evaluation responses.
